Nothing in the repo actually specifies what the current client install command is — `docs/setup.md` just has a TODO placeholder, and the only related note I found (in `.mneme/project_memory.json`) is a rule saying the docs must *not* reference `legacy-client`, without stating what the supported replacement is.

I don't want to guess/fabricate an install command (package name, flags, or URL), since that risks putting a wrong or unsafe instruction into a setup guide. Could you tell me the actual supported client install command (e.g. package name and install tool) so I can add it to `docs/setup.md`?
